name: Polychrome Bowl with Abstract Geometric Motifs
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Polychrome Bowl with Abstract Geometric Motifs” by Cibola (1000–1400), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 52787. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
